best_idea: Resolve each hit into presentation on every client from one compact server event (joint index, joint-local point, normal and direction, def and surface ids), where the surface picks a random variant and the entity's own table overrides the damage definition, so decals and bleeds are never a second source of truth.
decision_why: Take the shape (one server hit record, surface-keyed cosmetic variants with an entity-over-def fallback, one gib per body behind a global window). Drop Doom 3's physics gibs and world-decal projection: they do not fit a fixed-camera Pit with at most three attackers (MAX_ATTACKERS = 3), so Frankendom uses flat gib pieces.
acceptance: In one Pit fight two clients receive the same server hit event and show the same wound on the same joint within one frame; a server test asserts the hit event carries joint index and joint-local point, normal and direction (no world-space point), and a gib blocked by the 200 ms window leaves the body not-gibbed so the next damage call can gib it.
